title: Two-step sign-in
summary: KloudC masters: protect your login with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app.

items: Sign in with Store ID **PLATFORM**, your username and password.
Open **Two-step sign-in** and scan the QR code with an authenticator app (or type the key shown).
Type the current 6-digit code to turn it on.
From then on, sign-in asks for the code after your password. Codes change every 30 seconds.
The key is shown once. Scan it on a second device too if you want a spare.
The platform can require two-step for every master. Until you set it up, the console asks you to.
Lost every device? The server's operator has to clear two-step for your login, then you set it up again.
